notes.title: Version Adjustment, Repair, and Update Announcement V0.1
notes.content:
1. Adjust the initial game characters to "Cyberpunk" and "Scavenger".
2. Adjust and reduce the consumption of the character's physical system in task mode.
3. Adjust and increase the number of bullets dropped by enemies in mission mode.
4. Adjust and reduce the damage range after special airdrops hit the ground.
5. The issue of equipment and weapons not being synchronized after changing the character.
3. The problem of data synchronization not working properly after upgrading the role task.

notes.title: Announcement of Version Problem Repair and Update Plan
notes.content:
（Version Adjustment, Repair, and Update Announcement V0.1
In order to match the normal configuration and run the game smoothly, the default image quality will be adjusted to the lowest setting. High demand players can modify their own configuration in the game settings.
2. Adjust the initial game characters to "Cyberpunk" and "Scavenger".
3. Adjust and reduce the consumption of the character's physical system in task mode.
4. Adjust and increase the number of bullets dropped by enemies in mission mode.
5. Adjust and reduce the damage range after special airdrops hit the ground.）


（Plan Version Adjustment, Repair, and Update Announcement V0.2
1. The issue of equipment and weapons not being synchronized after changing the character.
2. There is an issue where the model accessories cannot be displayed after upgrading the weapon.
3. The problem of data synchronization not working properly after upgrading the role task.）


（Plan version adjustment, repair, and update announcement V0.3
1. Fix the problem where the equipment grenade cannot switch to a firearm normally under special circumstances after use.
2. Fix the issue where firearms cannot be switched normally under special circumstances after using the phone.
3. Fix the issue where the map does not display the marked location after using the mobile GPS positioning function.）
